title: Subtracting with -
idea: The - sign takes one number away from another. print(10 - 3) shows 7.

exercises.explanation: The - sign means subtract. 10 take away 3 is 7.

exercises.prompt: Order matters with subtraction: 10 - 3 and 3 - 10 are different.
exercises.explanation: 10 - 3 is 7. 3 - 10 is below zero. Unlike adding, the order changes the answer.

exercises.prompt: You had 20 and spent 5. Which instruction shows what's left?
exercises.explanation: Spending means taking away, so subtract: print(20 - 5) shows 15.

exercises.prompt:
Fill the blank so the screen shows 6:

print(9 ____ 3)
exercises.explanation: 9 - 3 is 6. The - sign tells the computer to subtract.

exercises.prompt: Build an instruction that subtracts 4 from 15 and shows the result.
exercises.explanation: print(15 - 4) shows 11. The bigger number goes first here because we take 4 away from 15.

exercises.prompt: Which instruction shows the result of taking 7 away from 7?
exercises.explanation: print(7 - 7) does the math and shows 0.
It has quotes, so it's text — shown exactly as 50 - 10. Only without quotes would it do the math and show 40.

exercises.prompt: Write a full instruction that subtracts 12 from 30 and shows the result.
